name: Product-page facts gap review
summary: Product by product, your merchandiser sees what a shopper's AI assistant needs from each page and does not get: facts the description leaves out, images with no alt text, buyer questions left unanswered. Each gap comes with a sourced draft to fill it, waiting for the owner's approval.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's product-facts package in its public shopify-skills repository (Fully-Powered-AI/shopify-skills), published under the MIT licence: the store's own list of facts per product line, a source named on every drafted line, open questions in place of guesses, and the approver's mark before anything reaches the store.
